title: The Jar That Counted Rain
youtube_title: The Jar That Counted Rain | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Curiosity means looking closely, asking questions, and checking your idea in more than one place.
summary: Fatima and Gus wonder how much rain fell in the night. They make a simple rain gauge from a clear jar. A second jar under a leafy bush collects less, and they discover that where you put the jar changes what it tells you.
